c-cron.1.evidence: wp action-scheduler action list --group=jetonomy --status=pending --per_page=200 shows pending trust_evaluation, cleanup_expired, prune_activity, cleanup_notifications, verification_reminder, reconcile_rosters, cleanup_media (the CLI default page of 5 rows hides most; needs --per_page)

c-cron.2.evidence: Pro active: pro_send_daily_digest, pro_send_weekly_digest, pro_evaluate_badges, pro_license_check (+edd_sl weekly cron for both) each pending exactly once; pro_ai_batch_review not pending (AI off); after a second activation still one each

c-cron.3.evidence: Deactivated jetonomy-pro then jetonomy: 0 pending jetonomy_* actions remain, only edd_sl cron events, no fatal in debug.log

c-cron.4.evidence: Ran the 7 free recurring hooks plus pro_prune_webhook_deliveries and pro_evaluate_badges via action-scheduler action run: each 'Executed 1 action' and status complete; no new debug.log error. Pro daily/weekly digest and license check not run (would mass-mail / call licence server)

c-cron.5.evidence: deactivate then activate jetonomy+pro in sequence: all 7 free and 4 pro recurring events rescheduled once each, /community/messages/ answers 302 (login redirect), /community/ 200. Side effect: a pending jetonomy_pro_rbe_imap_poll and badges_eval_user were dropped by the deactivate and not re-armed

c-cron.6.evidence: Fixture expired global_ban (user n1) and expired invite: after jetonomy_cleanup_expired the ban row is gone; invite row 574 kept and /community/invite/<token>/ says 'expired or reached its usage limit' (unknown token says 'Invalid invite link.'). Fixtures removed

c-cron.7.evidence: tier roster row in private space 4955 with no rule: jetonomy_reconcile_rosters removed it; manual row for admin kept

c-cron.8.evidence: On a full clone of the site DB (not forums.local) seeded with 5,000 extra profiles (5,047 with trust_level<4): Cron::evaluate_trust_batch ran 11 times, cursor jetonomy_trust_eval_cursor advanced 900452, 900952 ... 904952 in 500-row slices and was deleted after the last partial slice; slowest run 0.03s. No promotions occurred with the seeded stats, so the promotion write path was not exercised on this run

c-cron.9.evidence: bob scheduled a topic for 10:04:20 UTC (draft): hook run at 10:02:40 left it draft and re-armed; run at 10:04:24 published it at 10:04:25; subscribed follower alice got one new_post_in_sub notice

c-cron.10.evidence: Action Scheduler cannot be made missing on this site: Jetonomy bundles its own copy (libs/action-scheduler) and woocommerce, lifterlms, sensei, pmpro and wpmediaverse ship others, so as_enqueue_async_action stays defined with every other copy skipped. Code read: Queue::has_as() falls back to WP-Cron silently, and a grep of includes/ finds no admin notice for a missing Action Scheduler, so the 'shows a notice' half of the check has no implementation

c-cron.11.evidence: Pro deactivate/reactivate: failed rows unchanged (attachments_gc 5, daily 5, weekly 3, evaluate_badges 4, prune_webhook 3); no new 'no callbacks are registered' failures

c-cron.12.evidence: Expired invite rows are kept by design (see .6): after cleanup_expired the row stayed and the link says expired

proposed_checks.text: Reword .10: Jetonomy bundles Action Scheduler, so the missing-AS case needs a build without libs/action-scheduler; decide whether a notice should exist at all.
